$comment: NEW-53 exponentialTalk, slice (b) speak replies. THE voice settings x4 and the spoken-reply rules (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/voice.ts; desktop domain::voice; iOS ExpCore Voice.swift and Android domain/Voice.kt mirror `copy` only until the phones speak). STORAGE: `devices.launch_defaults.voice` = {assistantAgentId?, speakReplies?}, device-level like `computerUse`, owner-only, written through devices.setLaunchDefaults; a save WITHOUT a `voice` key keeps the stored one, `voice: null` clears it. UI: Device settings gains ONE group under the header `copy.group`: row `copy.assistant` = THE picker over the member's agents (`assistantOptions`: every agent in the member's teams, label = the agent's name, `{name} · {team}` when two agents share a name; the first option is `copy.assistantNone` = no assistant), then the toggle row `copy.speakReplies` (disabled while no assistant). The rows render on all four clients wherever the device's settings render (own device and another device of the same member); only the desktop app speaks in this slice. SPEAKING (desktop): `shouldSpeak` decides whether a synced `messages` row is spoken: author_kind `agent`, no card, non-blank body, no author_session_id (a child's post is not the assistant talking), the row belongs to the member's conversation session with the assistant agent (`assistantSessionId`), speakReplies on, and created at or after the moment the watcher armed (a backfill is never read aloud). The text spoken is `spokenText(body)`: Markdown reduced to what a voice can say, in order: fenced code blocks and tables are dropped; images are dropped; a link keeps its text; a bare URL becomes `copy.link`; inline code, emphasis, strike, heading and quote markers are unwrapped; list bullets and numbers drop; a mention `@local@domain` keeps `local`; an issue ref `#EXP-12` loses the `#`; an identifier `ABC-123` is spelled letter by letter and its number read the way people say issue numbers (`identifierNumberWords`: 1-3 digits as a cardinal, 4 digits as two pairs with `hundred` for a trailing 00 and `oh` for a leading 0 in the second pair, `x000` as a cardinal, 5+ digits digit by digit), an all-caps word of 2-5 letters is spelled letter by letter (the voice's lexicon has no such words and SKIPS what it does not know: measured in the NEW-52 spike); any other number becomes English cardinal words (`numberWords`: integers up to 999,999,999, a decimal reads `point` then each digit, `%` reads `percent`); whitespace collapses; the result stops at the last sentence end within `maxChars` (else at a word boundary + `copy.ellipsis`). While a reply is spoken the session shows a Dock banner (dock.json `Banner`: icon `media-volume-up`, label `copy.speaking`, title = the spoken text's first sentence, action `copy.stop`, tone muted); Stop ends the voice. The voice model downloads on first use (pinned + sha256, never in the binary); while it downloads the toggle row's trailing detail reads `copy.downloading`; a failed download is a toast `copy.downloadFailed` and the switch stays on (retried on the next reply).
